note: In `pockets true`, `.root` accesses `.right` and the collapsed singleton `.left`, while `.right` cannot access `.left`. This falsifies `EuclideanAt` at `.root`. Full-predicate collapse is possible from `.root`, but `.right` and `.twin` see only their own noncollapsed pair. Thus `◇MC` holds at `.root` and `□◇MC` fails there for full-predicate collapse. The fixed-language row satisfies `□◇MC`.
